name: The Full English for Dinner
blurb: Bacon, sausage, eggs, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes and toast — any time.
method: Start the sausages slow in a pan or low oven.
Fry the bacon, then the mushrooms and tomatoes in the fat.
Warm the beans; fry the eggs to order; toast the bread.
Plate everything with brown sauce or ketchup.

name: Shakshuka
blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce with feta and bread.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp caraway, chilli to taste
method: Soften the onion and pepper, add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 12-15 minutes until thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 5-7 minutes.
Crumble over feta and coriander; serve with bread.

name: Croque Madame
blurb: Grilled ham and cheese under béchamel and gruyère, topped with a fried egg.
ingredients: 20g butter, 20g flour, 250ml milk, 1 tsp Dijon, nutmeg
method: Make a thick béchamel; stir in the mustard, nutmeg and a third of the cheese.
Build sandwiches with ham and cheese, toast in a pan, then transfer to a tray.
Spread the béchamel over, scatter with the rest of the cheese, and grill until bubbling.
Fry the eggs and sit one on each; serve with salad.

name: Bacon & Maple Pancake Stack
blurb: Fluffy American pancakes with crispy streaky bacon and lots of maple syrup.
ingredients: 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch of salt
Butter for the pan, maple syrup
method: Fry the bacon until crisp; keep warm.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then beat in the egg, milk and butter to a thick batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip.
Stack with the bacon and drown in maple syrup.

name: Eggs Benedict
blurb: Poached eggs and ham on toasted muffins under a quick blender hollandaise.
ingredients: Hollandaise: 3 egg yolks, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 150g melted butter, pinch of cayenne
method: Blitz the yolks and lemon juice, then pour in the hot butter in a thin stream until thick; season.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes.
Top the toasted muffins with ham (or spinach) and the eggs.
Spoon over the hollandaise and dust with cayenne.

name: Spanish Tortilla
blurb: A thick potato and onion omelette, set soft in the middle.
method: Gently cook the potatoes and onions in the oil over low heat for 20 minutes until soft, not coloured; drain (keep the oil).
Beat the eggs, fold in the potatoes and onions, and season.
Cook in a little of the oil over low heat for 8 minutes, then flip onto a plate and slide back to set the other side.
Rest 5 minutes; serve warm or at room temperature with salad.

name: Breakfast Burrito
blurb: Scrambled egg, sausage, cheese, hash brown and salsa rolled in a big tortilla.
ingredients: 4 sausages or 200g chorizo, cooked and sliced
method: Warm the tortillas.
Layer egg, sausage, a hash brown, cheese and salsa down the middle.
Fold in the ends and roll tightly.
Toast seam-down in a dry pan to seal and crisp.

name: Savoury French Toast with Bacon
blurb: Cheesy fried eggy bread topped with crispy bacon and a fried egg.
ingredients: 3 eggs, 4 tbsp milk, 40g grated Parmesan, chives
method: Whisk the eggs, milk, Parmesan and chives; soak the bread.
Fry the bacon until crisp; set aside.
Fry the soaked bread in butter until golden both sides.
Top with the bacon and a fried egg.

name: Kedgeree
blurb: Curried rice with smoked haddock, boiled eggs, peas and parsley.
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 tbsp mild curry powder, 1 bay leaf
method: Poach the haddock in simmering water for 4 minutes, then flake.
Fry the onion in butter, add the curry powder and bay, then the rice.
Add 550ml water, cover and cook 12 minutes, adding the peas at the end.
Fold through the fish, halved eggs, parsley and lemon.

name: Menemen
blurb: Soft eggs cooked into a spiced Turkish pepper and tomato base, scooped with bread.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Turkish pepper paste or purée
Butter and olive oil, crusty bread
method: Soften the peppers in butter and oil for 6-8 minutes.
Add the pepper paste and tomatoes and cook to a thick sauce.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat until just set.
Serve straight from the pan with bread.

name: Loaded Breakfast Hash
blurb: Crispy potato, sausage and pepper hash baked with eggs cracked on top.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli flakes
method: Fry the potatoes and sausage in an ovenproof pan until crisp and browned.
Add the peppers, onion and spices and cook 5 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; scatter with cheese.
Bake at 200C fan for 8-10 minutes until the eggs are set; finish with spring onions and hot sauce.

name: Roast Veg & Feta Frittata
blurb: An oven-baked frittata packed with roasted vegetables and feta.
ingredients: 1 courgette, 1 pepper, 1 red onion, 200g cherry tomatoes, roasted
method: Beat the eggs with the milk, herbs and Parmesan; season.
Fold in the roasted vegetables in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in the eggs, scatter with feta, and cook on the hob for 3 minutes.
Finish under the grill or in a 190C oven for 10-12 minutes until set; serve with salad.

name: Brunch Toad in the Hole with Bacon
blurb: Sausages and bacon baked in Yorkshire batter, with a fried egg on top.
method: Whisk the batter and rest 30 minutes.
Heat the oil, sausages and bacon in a roasting tin at 220C fan for 8 minutes.
Pour in the batter and bake 25-30 minutes without opening the door.
Serve topped with fried eggs and a side of beans.

name: Cheesy Crumpets with Poached Eggs & Spinach
blurb: Toasted crumpets loaded with melted cheese, garlicky spinach and poached eggs.
ingredients: 200g spinach, 1 garlic clove, knob of butter
method: Toast the crumpets, top with cheese and grill until molten.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic and butter.
Poach the eggs.
Top the crumpets with spinach and eggs; finish with chilli flakes and pepper.

name: Baked Eggs with Chorizo & Potato
blurb: Sautéed potato and chorizo with eggs baked on top and lots of paprika oil.
method: Fry the chorizo until its oil runs, add the potatoes and fry until crisp.
Add the onion, pepper, garlic and paprika, then the tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Bake at 200C fan for 8-10 minutes until set; finish with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Chicken & Waffles
blurb: Crispy fried chicken on fluffy waffles with hot sauce and maple syrup.
ingredients: 200g seasoned flour with paprika, garlic and onion powder, cayenne
Waffle batter: 250g flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 350ml buttermilk, 60g melted butter
method: Dredge the chicken and fry at 170C for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked; drain.
Whisk the waffle batter and cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp.
Stack chicken on the waffles.
Drizzle with hot sauce and maple syrup.
